params.prompt: Preserve the exact photographic composition of this electricity transmission tower and humid hillside corridor. One continuous restrained six-second shot. The steel tower and all conductor lines remain completely rigid and geometrically stable. Camera makes an extremely slow forward dolly of only a few feet; foreground wet grasses move gently in wind, low mist flows almost imperceptibly left to right behind the tower, a subtle warm horizon break stays fixed. Keep the tower centered and equally visible throughout for a portrait crop. The action is weather and parallax, never a transformation of equipment. No new structures, no line growth, no flickering or bend in the tower, no surge, no lightning, no electrical glow, no text, no graphics, no logos, no cuts. Documentary film photography, cool slate and mineral green, understated warm horizon, silent.
